# onpager_team_membership (Resource)

Manage a user's team membership and lead marker.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "onpager_team_membership" "example" {
  team_id = var.team_id
  user_id = var.user_id
  lead    = false
}

variable "team_id" {
  description = "Existing team UUID."
  type        = string
}

variable "user_id" {
  description = "Existing active user UUID; this resource does not create users."
  type        = string
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) Team UUID. Changing it replaces the membership. Must be a nonzero canonical lowercase UUID.
- `user_id` (String) Existing active user UUID. Changing it replaces the membership. Must be a nonzero canonical lowercase UUID.

### Optional

- `lead` (Boolean) Whether this membership has the lead marker, which affects team default roles. Defaults to `false`. This marker does not assign an explicit native RBAC role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite membership identity `team_uuid/user_uuid`, also used for import. Both components are nonzero canonical lowercase UUIDs.

## Import

Import using `team_uuid/user_uuid`. Import reads the exact membership, including
its lead marker.

Use an `import` block:

```terraform
import {
  to = onpager_team_membership.example
  id = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
}
```

Or use the CLI:

```shell
terraform import onpager_team_membership.example 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333
```

## Lifecycle

Destroy revokes the membership and preserves history. Recreating a revoked pair
uses the API's add operation. The lead marker participates in native team access
and default roles; it does not create an explicit RBAC role assignment.

Refresh and import use the direct membership read. Confirmed revoked or absent
memberships are removed from state. Authentication, authorization and transport
failures retain state.

Schedule participation can block removal unless explicit removal scopes are
provided. This resource does not send those scopes or modify rotations. Resolve
schedule dependencies before destroying the membership.

## Permissions

Requires `team_memberships.read`, `team_memberships.add` and
`team_memberships.remove` in the team. Setting the lead marker additionally
requires `team_leads.assign`; clearing it or deleting a lead membership requires
`team_leads.remove`.
